entities.name: André Lysenstøen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Lysenstøen is a Norwegian ice hockey coach and former professional ice hockey goaltender. He has served as head coach of the Norwegian women's national ice hockey team since 2023. During his goaltending career, Lysenstøen played in the Norwegian Eliteserien with Lillehammer IK, the Stavanger Oilers, and Manglerud Star, and in the Finnish Mestis with HeKi.
